raw_segments.text: Pyotr Ilyich was simply dumbfounded when he went into the police captains.
He saw instantly that everyone knew.
They had positively thrown down their cards.
All were standing up and talking.
Even Nikolay Parfenevich had left the young ladies and run in, looking strenuous and ready
Pyotr Ilyich was met with the astounding news that old Fyodor Pavlovich really had been
murdered that evening in his own house, murdered and robbed.
The news had only just reached them in the following manner.
